title: A sync conflict is answered on the dashboard, field by field
description: When the Sync button gets `conflicted`, show each record both sides changed with its fields, and per field the two values to pick from — nothing preselected (same rule as the MCP sync elicitation). Submitting calls the existing `resolve` route (packages/server/src/routes.ts:245, core resolveConflict), then syncs again to push. So nobody needs a terminal to finish a sync. Build it as its own component under apps/dashboard/src/sync/ with its test.
